name: cargo-bdd --help
stdout:
Diagnostic tooling for rstest-bdd

Usage: <CARGO_BDD_ROOT_BINARY> <COMMAND>

Commands:
  steps       List all registered steps
  unused      List registered steps that were never executed
  duplicates  List step definitions that share the same keyword and pattern
  skipped     List skipped scenarios and their reasons
  help        Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

stdout:
